source: The operator's first live test of the demonstration page, 11 September 2026. He typed one sentence carrying a past-tense third-person report and a modal give-up; it read MISS and seated a persona. Two lexicon gaps, closed 2026-09-17: the direct-ideation stems did not carry their past tenses ('killed', 'took', 'ended'), and the inconclusive set listed only the bare 'i give up'. The strings here are the project's synthetic restatements of the two forms plus the idiom controls that must keep reading MISS; his own sentence is added verbatim when he supplies it.
notes: A lexicon gap a person finds in one minute of typing is the ceiling argument in miniature (see known_gaps.json): tense and mood are not what a regular-expression lexicon is good at. Both forms now fail closed; the over-restriction controls in this file are the price of that and are asserted too.

cases.text: my friend killed themselves last year and I keep thinking about it
cases.why: A past-tense, third-person report of a suicide. Before 2026-09-17 'kill' and 'killing' matched and 'killed' did not, so this proceeded to a persona. Tense does not waive the gate; suicide bereavement is itself a risk factor, and the card's own fourth line opens the door back if the read was wrong.

expect.reason_contains: crisis read INCONCLUSIVE -> HUMAN_ESCALATION by fail-closed policy

cases.why: The modal form of the surrender. Before 2026-09-17 only the bare 'i give up' was in the inconclusive set, so this went unresolved with nobody seated and no card. Ambiguous on purpose: it is recorded as inconclusive, not as a hit, and fails closed under the crisis card's uncertainty policy.

cases.text: we might as well give up
cases.why: The subjectless modal ('might as well') is the same surrender in the plural; it fails closed like the first-person form.

cases.text: I nearly killed myself laughing at that video
cases.why: Over-restriction control for the new past-tense pattern: the laughter idiom is masked before the lexicon runs, so widening 'kill' to 'killed' did not make a joke into a card.

cases.text: I should just give up sugar
cases.why: Over-restriction control for the new modal pattern: giving up a named habit is masked, so 'I should just give up sugar' stays an ordinary sentence.
